title: Key Account Manager – Modern Trade (FMCG)
summary: Drive commercial volume, listing agreements, and Joint Business Planning (JBP) with key national hypermarket and supermarket accounts including Carrefour, Lulu, Union Coop, and West Zone.
responsibilities: Manage tier-one modern trade accounts, planogram execution, and in-store promotional calendars; Analyze POS sell-through and SKU velocity to optimize replenishment cycles across store clusters; Lead commercial trading terms negotiations, promotional rebates, and new SKU listings
requirements: Proven track record managing UAE modern trade accounts in FMCG, personal care, or food sectors; Valid UAE driving license and established commercial relationships with retail buying teams; Strong analytical skills, commercial numeracy, and presentation fluency

title: Brand Marketing Executive – Beauty & Personal Care
summary: Execute omnichannel brand activation, consumer campaigns, in-store merchandising guidelines, and digital brand presence for our international beauty and personal care portfolio.
responsibilities: Coordinate product launches, promotional displays, and retailer co-marketing campaigns; Manage influencer outreach, localized social media content calendars, and beauty press PR; Track marketing ROI, brand penetration metrics, and competitor benchmark analysis in the UAE market
requirements: Demonstrated marketing experience within beauty, skincare, cosmetics, or FMCG brands in the GCC; Creative eye for visual merchandising and premium brand storytelling; Strong bilingual communication (English required; Arabic is an advantage)

title: Supply Chain & Logistics Coordinator
summary: Oversee inbound freight forwarding, customs clearance, warehouse receiving, inventory control, and multi-channel fulfillment across modern trade, general trade, and pharmacy networks in all 7 Emirates.
responsibilities: Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, and Dubai Customs / DP World for expedited clearance; Monitor stock holding levels, expiry tracking (FIFO/FEFO), and warehouse dispatch scheduling; Ensure regulatory compliance documentation for Dubai Municipality and MOHAP inbound shipments
requirements: Extensive knowledge of UAE import/export documentation, Mirsal II, and customs protocols; Proficiency in ERP inventory modules and multi-warehouse stock management; Experience handling temperature-sensitive personal care, OTC, or FMCG goods

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist – OTC & Healthcare
summary: Spearhead product registration dossiers, label assessments, and regulatory approvals with the UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention (MOHAP) and Dubai Municipality (Montaji).
responsibilities: Compile, review, and submit technical dossiers for cosmetic, nutritional, and OTC healthcare products; Liaise directly with health authorities to expedite product classification and commercial clearance; Ensure ongoing compliance with regional GSO standards, ingredient bans, and mandatory Arabic labeling
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Biomedical Sciences, Chemistry, or relevant discipline; Proven direct experience with UAE MOHAP and Dubai Municipality Montaji portals; Deep understanding of GCC cosmetic regulations and dietary supplement frameworks

title: Food & Beverage Category Sales Specialist
summary: Spearhead distribution expansion for packaged food products, culinary staples, and pantry FMCG across regional cooperative societies, supermarkets, and specialty food retail channels.
responsibilities: Expand distribution footprint for ambient packaged foods and gourmet grocery lines across UAE retail; Coordinate shelf placement, promotional end-caps, and seasonal tasting activations; Monitor order fulfillment, credit cycles, and on-shelf availability
requirements: Solid background in UAE food & beverage distribution or grocery modern/traditional trade; Knowledge of food safety norms, retail shelf dynamics, and consumer pantry purchasing behaviors; Self-driven with strong customer relationship management capability
